title: Skills management CHANGELOG row
description: One record per skill publish. Governance plan `docs/plans/skills-governance-plan.md` section 6; PRD `docs/prd/02-phase8-skills-management.md` R8.5. Validator: `tools/skills/validate-changelog.sh`. This is a JSONL row schema — the file `docs/skills/CHANGELOG.jsonl` is one JSON object per line.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the publish (moment publish.sh appended the row, NOT the source commit).

skill.description: The skill directory name under `skill/` (also the folder name under `~/.claude/skills/`). Extended additively when a new skill is added.

task.description: Jira Task key whose commit is being published.

commit.description: Full 40-character git SHA of the development-copy commit under `skill/<name>/`.

lesson.description: Root-cause lesson (free text). Empty allowed but discouraged.

status.description: Row status. publish.sh writes 'published' on a successful publish; 'draft' and 'reviewed' may be appended by hand for audit.

intent_id.description: server_intents.intent_id from POST /actions/skills/publish; null when written from the CLI without going through the web endpoint. Used by the production test-guard (T10) to correlate a filesystem mutation with a legitimate publish.
